Downtown.name: Downtown
Downtown.description: Wall Street and Bond Street core with hotel/adaptive-reuse projects, the pedestrian riverfront, and the metro's densest mixed-use permitting corridor.

Old Mill District.name: Old Mill District
Old Mill District.description: Redeveloped lumber-mill campus on the Deschutes River with destination retail, amphitheater, offices, and riverfront multifamily infill.

Westside & Century Drive.name: Westside & Century Drive
Westside & Century Drive.description: Century Drive corridor and southwest residential hills with strip-center retail, medical offices, and steady residential renovation permits.

Northwest Crossing.name: Northwest Crossing
Northwest Crossing.description: New-urbanist planned community with mixed-use Main Street, alley-loaded cottages, and the metro's strongest new-build permit pipeline.

Awbrey Butte.name: Awbrey Butte
Awbrey Butte.description: Upper-west hillside with view-lot estate builds, Skyline Ranch Road development, and top-end residential construction permits.

Orchard District.name: Orchard District
Orchard District.description: Northeast historic orchard neighborhood with Craftsman-era housing, NE 3rd Street retail spine, and moderate renovation and ADU permits.

River West.name: River West
River West.description: North riverfront corridor along the Deschutes with park-adjacent residential and light industrial-to-residential conversions.

Old Farm District.name: Old Farm District
Old Farm District.description: Historic southeast farm settlement around Reed Market Road with mid-century ranch stock and steady infill and redevelopment permits.

Southern Crossing.name: Southern Crossing
Southern Crossing.description: South-central neighborhood around SE 3rd and Reed Market with a densifying mixed-use node and growing multifamily development.

Larkspur.name: Larkspur
Larkspur.description: Southern Bend residential fringe with Larkspur Trail Park, recent master-planned tracts, and family-oriented new construction.
